Key observations from the test image:
- Split soybean stems showing bleached/white interior
- Large black masses embedded within the stem tissue — these are sclerotia
- Stems appear completely dead and dried out

This strongly points to **White Mold** (Sclerotinia stem rot). The characteristic black sclerotia embedded inside bleached white stems is the hallmark symptom. Let me confirm with the reference.

The reference confirms White Mold: bleached white stems with characteristic black sclerotia. The test image shows the interior of split stems with massive black sclerotia bodies — the definitive diagnostic sign of Sclerotinia/White Mold.
